items.a: Playlist Push is a fully legitimate music promotion platform founded in 2017 that has supported over 50,000 artists, managers, and labels. We are a US-based company with a 4.5+ rating and have been recognized by Rolling Stone, Wired, and NPR. Unlike unverified services that may use fake bot streams, we offer a transparent, pay-for-review model that connects you with real human curators, ensuring your growth is organic and safe for your artist profile.

items.q: How does a Playlist Push Spotify promotion campaign work?
items.a: Our platform uses a sophisticated genre-matching system to connect your song with the most relevant independent curators. When setting up a campaign, you simply select your track's genres, mood, and language. Our system then identifies curators who manage active playlists in those specific categories. These curators provide a professional review; if they find the track is a good fit, they add it to their playlist, generating organic listener signals that help you find real fans.

items.q: What is a Pre-Release Campaign and how does it benefit my launch?
items.a: A Pre-Release Campaign allows you to secure playlist commitments before your official release date. By clustering activity on day one, you send powerful engagement signals to the Spotify algorithm right when they matter most. Data shows that artists using this feature see a significant increase in first-week streams and higher chances of landing on algorithmic playlists like Discover Weekly.

items.q: How do curators hear my music before it is officially released?
items.a: When you set up a pre-release campaign, you securely upload your unreleased track directly to our platform. We deliver this audio to our network of trusted curators, allowing them to listen, provide feedback, and commit to adding the track to their playlists ahead of time. This ensures all placements go live within the first 48 hours of your track hitting Spotify.

items.q: Is using Playlist Push safe for my Spotify for Artists account?
items.a: Yes. We prioritize your long-term account health by strictly adhering to Spotify's anti-fraud policies. Our service is designed to be fully compliant, as we do not use bot-driven traffic or artificial engagement—the primary causes of platform flags. By facilitating 100% human reviews through our vetted curator network, we ensure your data remains clean, authentic, and safe for your artist profile.

items.q: How does Playlist Push help trigger the Spotify algorithm?
items.a: To qualify for Discover Weekly or Release Radar, Spotify requires seed data like high save rates and low skip rates. Playlist Push helps generate these high-intent signals by placing your song in front of active listeners. When our curators add your track, it tells the Spotify algorithm exactly who your ideal listener is, which is the primary driver for getting picked up by Spotify Radio and other automated recommendations.

items.q: What is the minimum budget for a Spotify campaign?
items.a: Spotify campaigns on Playlist Push start at $280. This minimum ensures your release reaches a critical mass of curators to generate actionable data. In digital music promotion, smaller budgets often fail to create the statistical volume required for the Spotify algorithm to recognize a trend. This investment allows your song to reach enough curators to produce meaningful algorithmic momentum.

items.q: How do you ensure the quality of the playlists in your network?
items.a: We maintain the most rigorous standards in the music promotion industry. Every playlist in our network is subject to a high-level vetting process that combines human expertise with ongoing monitoring to ensure only authentic, active playlists are included. Over 99% of curator applications are turned down. Once a curator is admitted, their playlists are continuously reviewed to ensure they remain healthy and provide real value to artists. Our commitment to quality means your budget is focused exclusively on genuine discovery within a high-integrity ecosystem.

items.q: What is the best music promotion service for Spotify?
items.a: The best music promotion services share a few traits you can verify before spending a dollar: real human curators instead of bots, transparent pay-for-review pricing rather than pay-for-placement, compliance with Spotify's Terms of Service, and reporting that shows exactly where your money went. Playlist Push is consistently ranked among the best music promotion services on all of these criteria. Since 2017 we have run campaigns for over 50,000 artists, managers, and labels, hold a 4.5+ rating, and have been featured by Rolling Stone, Wired, and NPR. Whichever service you choose, avoid any company that guarantees placements or streams, as that model relies on manipulation that can get your music removed from Spotify.

items.q: What makes Playlist Push different from SoundCampaign or SubmitHub?
items.a: Playlist Push is built for scale, precision, and safety. While platforms like SubmitHub require artists to manually pitch to individual curators, our genre-matching system automates the targeting process. Compared to SoundCampaign, Playlist Push offers a more established, rigorously vetted curator network and exclusive features like Pre-Release Campaigns, which allow you to build momentum before your song drops. We provide a premium service for serious artists who demand verified data and protection from streaming manipulation.

items.q: Can I get a refund if a curator doesn't like my song?
items.a: You are paying for a professional review and guaranteed consideration. While we cannot buy placements (this would violate Spotify's Terms of Service), we offer an Artist Protection Fund. If a curator fails to provide a qualitative, professional review of your music, the cost of that specific submission is automatically returned to your account balance. This ensures your promotion budget is only ever spent on curators who are actively engaged.

items.q: How long does it take to see results?
items.a: Most artists see their first curator reviews and playlist activity within 48 to 72 hours. You will receive real-time notifications via your Live Analytics Dashboard, allowing you to track placements, read feedback, and monitor your song's performance as it happens. Your campaign continues to run until your full budget has been utilized, ensuring maximum exposure and trajectory for your release.
